**Job Title: Mobile Application Developer – Trainee**

**Company Name: Codigix Infotech Pvt. Ltd.**

**Location: Pimpri, Pune.**

**Experience: Intern**

**Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred**

**About the Role**

Codigix Technologies is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Mobile Application Developer Intern** to join our development team. This role is ideal for freshers or candidates who have a strong interest in mobile application development and want to gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects.

The selected candidate will work under the guidance of senior developers and get exposure to developing and maintaining mobile applications for **Android and iOS platforms**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in developing and maintaining mobile applications under the guidance of senior developers.
* Convert UI/UX designs into responsive and user-friendly mobile interfaces.
* Integrate REST APIs and backend services into mobile applications.
* Work with JSON, databases, and third-party APIs.
* Debug, test, and troubleshoot application issues.
* Ensure applications perform smoothly across different devices and screen sizes.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and other project team members.
* Participate in code reviews and follow development and coding standards.
* Assist in implementing new features and application enhancements.
* Stay updated with new mobile development technologies and frameworks.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of mobile application development.
* Knowledge of **Flutter, React Native, Android, or iOS** is an advantage.
* Basic programming knowledge in **Dart, Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, or TypeScript**.
* Basic understanding of **REST APIs and JSON**.
* Basic knowledge of **Git and GitHub**.
* Good logical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

**Educational Qualification**

* BSc Computer Science / BCA / BE / BTech / MCA / MSc Computer Science or equivalent qualification.
* Freshers and candidates with academic, personal, or internship-based mobile application projects are encouraged to apply.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on knowledge of **Flutter or React Native**.
* Basic understanding of **Firebase**.
* Experience integrating APIs.
* Basic knowledge of **MySQL or other databases**.
* Familiarity with GitHub and version control.
* Academic or personal mobile application projects.
* Basic understanding of Android Studio or VS Code.

**What We Offer**

* Hands-on experience working on **real-world mobile application projects**.
* Training and mentorship from experienced developers.
* Exposure to **Android and iOS application development**.
* Practical experience with APIs, databases, Firebase, ERP, CRM, and AI-based applications.
* Opportunity to improve programming and problem-solving skills.
* Learning and career growth opportunities.
* Potential opportunity for a full-time role based on performance and organizational requirements.

**Who Can Apply?**

* Freshers with a strong interest in mobile application development.
* Final-year students or recent graduates from relevant technical backgrounds.
* Candidates who have completed mobile development courses or projects.
* Candidates looking to build a career in **Flutter / React Native / Mobile Application Development**.

description:

**741642 - Tech Manager — Mobile Architect -Subcon**
====================================================

Join Techila's team of Salesforce experts. We build senior-led transformations that deliver measurable outcomes for clients worldwide.

Experience

10–25 yrs

Employment Type

Full-time

Ruby on Rails

**Job Description**
-------------------

Job Description :

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Tech Manager with a Mobile Architect profile to own the technical direction of cross-platform mobile products and to lead the engineers who build them.

This is a dual role by design. On the architecture side you will define mobile architecture, coding standards, release pipelines and long-term maintainability across iOS, Android and Flutter. On the management side you will lead one or more squads, run 1:1s and performance cycles, hire, and grow engineers.

You will work directly with Product and Design to refine requirements, estimate effort and surface cross-team dependencies, and you will be the technical voice the client trusts on mobile decisions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Define and own mobile architecture across platforms — architectural patterns, modularisation, state management, design-system adoption and long-term maintainability.

Author and drive the mobile technical roadmap, including refactoring cycles and technical-debt reduction, and make the business case for them.

Set and enforce engineering standards: merge-request workflows, peer review, test strategy and unit-test coverage, static analysis.

Own CI/CD pipelines, build automation, release management and store submission for QA, client validation and production.

Lead one or more cross-functional squads (mobile, and where applicable front-end), coordinating task delivery and providing day-to-day technical guidance.

Conduct code reviews and act as the technical quality gate before release.

Facilitate collaboration across App, BFF, Web, Content, Design and Product teams; track sprint progress and actively manage cross-team dependencies.

Partner with Product and Design to refine requirements, estimate effort and challenge scope where technically unsound.

Manage, mentor and develop engineers: 1:1s, coaching, career guidance, OKRs and performance reviews.

Lead hiring and onboarding — job profile definition, technical interviewing, and ramp-up of new engineers.

Raise documentation and knowledge-sharing standards; run tech talks and internal R&D initiatives.

Represent mobile engineering in client-facing technical discussions and delivery governance.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

10+ years in mobile engineering, with at least 4 years in a technical leadership or engineering management capacity.

Deep hands-on experience in native mobile development: Swift and Objective-C (iOS) and/or Kotlin and Java (Android), at advanced level.

Strong cross-platform experience with Flutter and Dart, including when to choose cross-platform over native and how to defend that decision.

Demonstrated ownership of mobile architecture on at least one enterprise-scale product — you set the architecture, not just worked within it.

Proven line-management experience: direct reports, 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching and career development.

Hands-on CI/CD experience for mobile (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitrise, Jenkins or equivalent) including automated build and release pipelines.

Strong Agile / Scrum delivery experience leading squads of 5–12 engineers.

Experience with Firebase (or equivalent) for analytics, crash reporting, remote config and distribution.

Experience hiring and onboarding mobile engineers, from job profile to ramp-up.

Client-facing credibility: able to run a technical conversation with product owners and client stakeholders without a delivery manager in the room.

Professional working proficiency in English.

NICE TO HAVE

Additional platform experience: tvOS, wearables, or high-concurrency VOD / live-streaming products.

Front-end experience (JavaScript, Vue or React) to lead blended mobile and web squads.

Strong UX and usability instincts — user testing and A/B testing experience to inform feature prioritisation.

Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, or having shipped an AI-enabled internal tool or product feature.

Experience with design-system definition and rollout across platforms.

Additional languages (Spanish, and others relevant to the account).

Experience managing blended in-house, outsourced and Full Timeor teams.

description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. **About Position:**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Qt Android Developer to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of advanced mobile network testing solutions used by telecom operators worldwide. The role involves building and enhancing applications within the TEMS Pocket, TEMS Fleet, and TEMS Sense product portfolio. You will be responsible for Android application development, network testing capabilities, automation frameworks, device integrations, geolocation services, and performance optimization using Android, C++, and Qt technologies.

* Design, develop, and improve automation, scripting, and test-execution frameworks.
* Develop controller-agent communication modules and integrate REST APIs with enterprise systems.
* Implement device connectivity and communication features across multiple mobile devices and testing environments.
* Integrate GPS, geolocation services, mapping, route history, and navigation functionality into mobile applications.
* Support voice quality testing solutions, including POLQA and AQM integrations.
* Optimize application performance, memory utilization, application responsiveness, stability, and battery consumption.
* Investigate and resolve customer-reported issues related to devices, applications, connectivity, and network measurements.
* Participate in product validation, testing, release management, defect resolution, and production support activities.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, code quality initiatives, and development best practices.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, QA, Product Management, Managed Services, and Support teams.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, architecture planning, and technical documentation activities.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 5–10 years of experience in Android application development and software engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience in Android development using Kotlin and/or Java.
* Expertise working with Android SDK, background services, networking components, and application lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience developing applications using C++ and the Qt Framework.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, mobile application architecture, and device communication frameworks.
* Experience in Android debugging, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and memory optimization.
* Good understanding of mobile networking technologies and communication protocols.
* Experience with network testing tools and technologies such as iPerf, TWAMP, HTTP, and FTP.
* Knowledge of Wi-Fi, LTE, and 5G technologies is highly desirable.
* Exposure to telecom, mobile measurement, network diagnostic, or performance analytics applications is preferred.
* Experience integrating GPS, geospatial services, maps, navigation, and location-based services.
* Familiarity with controller-agent architecture and device-to-device communication models.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience using Git-based development workflows and code review processes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, Android security, application hardening, and target SDK upgrades.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed global teams and multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and technical documentation skills.

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
